background: Nykredit is Denmark's largest mortgage lender, a mutual-owned group that funds Danish residential and commercial mortgages through covered bonds under the Danish balance-principle system, with a commercial and retail bank alongside.
synthesis: Nykredit is rated AA- on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A+, one on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook, after a two-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Liquidity is very strong, with LCR of 501% and NSFR of 143% both in the top quarter of EU and Nordic banks, and CET1 of 17.0% is above the median, but leverage of 4.5% is in the bottom quarter, the usual pattern for a covered-bond mortgage lender. Since 30 Jun 2025 NSFR has risen 10 points, with CET1, leverage and LCR broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The one flagged item, on 14 Aug 2026, is a supervisory finding that an asset-management unit's investor documentation fell short, a conduct point rather than a credit one.
